text:
sam: CI red on master — integ-smoke suite failing in staging CI. Most failures are payment-mock returning 502s/timeouts. Rerun didn't help, seeing same failures across shards.

alex_m: seeing it too. /retest keeps failing. anyone seen related infra changes?

jess: checking mock-payment pods in staging-ci — one container keeps restarting, logs show OOM-ish churn, grabbing logs now.

rachel: pasted failing log snippet:

```
ERROR [http-server] Unhandled exception: java.lang.IllegalStateException: missing ENV PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL
  at com.redwood.payment.PaymentClient.init(PaymentClient.java:42)
  at com.redwood.payment.MockServer.start(MockServer.java:87)
  ...
```

curl health check shows 502:
```
$ curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://mock-payment.staging.svc/health
502
```

sam: ok that stack trace looks like an env propagation issue. @alex_m any config changes to CI envs recently?

alex_m: there was a small tweak in .ci/envs.yml yesterday to remove a fallback for PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL (PR #981). I can start a bisect but likely this is connected.

ci-bot: rerun requested by @alex_m for job integ-smoke #4321

rachel: quick manual workaround — setting PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8089 in the test config and restarting mock pod to see if tests proceed. Doing restart now.

deploy-bot: mock-payment test pod restarted in staging-ci (node ci-12). Pod status: Running.

sam: tests are coming back green on the restarted shard, 5/5 jobs passed on the rerun. Looks like missing env caused mock to fail and cascade to tests.

alex_m: opened infra PR to restore fallback and add CI guard: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-configs/pull/987 — includes a small test that verifies required envs are present during CI deploys.

jess: filing a short incident note in the runbook and marking this integ suite flaky until the PR is merged.

sam: agreed — short postmortem sufficient. Root cause: config change removed fallback for PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL -> mock server crashed with missing config -> 502s in tests. Fix merged and rolled out, reruns green. :thumbsup:

alex_m: will follow up with a retro note and add an alert if mock services restart >3x in 10m in staging CI.

rachel: thanks all — closing the oncall loop.
